s.t:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
TwoTwenty is Pinterest's incubation team. We invented Shuffles and Collages and we're the team behind Beauty Guides, Restyle and Smart Blocks. We're hiring a product manager to own one of our shipping products end to end, or to lead one of our next zero-to-one bets from a blank page to real users.

Own a product on TwoTwenty end to end, from strategy through post-launch iteration. You'll pick between a substantial slice of the teams AI Experiences charter or one of the team's next bets in areas like generative creation tools, live shopping or AI planning surfaces.
Make the product decisions that separate a demo from a product. You'll decide what ships in V1, defend the cut list and set the quality bar on your surface so designers and engineers calibrate to it.
Land launches that require alignment with partner teams inside Pinterest (AIFwd, Search, Shop with Pinterest, ATG). You'll get to agreement without needing your manager in the room.
Translate a company-level thesis into a concrete product decision your team can build against. You'll be able to state your product's strategy in one sentence and connect this week's engineering work to it.
Run experiments that answer real questions, not experiments that produce metrics. You'll decide when a null result is a launch signal and when a positive result isn't good enough.
Use AI to accelerate exploration, drafting and analysis in your day-to-day. This includes prototyping concepts, comparing design options and synthesizing user research, while applying judgment and verification to protect correctness and quality.
Mentor at least one PM or designer on the team on the craft of narrowing a problem before writing the doc.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience, including shipping a consumer product with an AI or ML component to at least one million users.
Experience owning a zero-to-one product from a blank page through real user traffic, not a prototype in a deck.
Experience saying no to a well-liked feature request from an executive and holding the line on quality.
Experience earning the trust of a senior engineering leader on architectural decisions, and can describe how you did it.
Understanding of the difference between a strategy and a plan, and the ability to state your current team's strategy in one sentence.
Experience using AI to accelerate product exploration, competitive analysis or user research synthesis, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality before decisions get made.
Committed to owning outcomes end to end. You treat things outside your scope as yours when the product needs it, and you don't lean on process to make decisions the team is looking to you for.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as computer science, design, human-computer interaction or business, or equivalent experience.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
As the Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how every team builds Vanta's interface.

Your mission is to build the horizontal tooling that lets product, engineering, and design teams create consistent, high-quality user experiences faster, so they can spend more of their time on their customers.

To be successful, you’ll need to have a high level of product taste and be able to set and hold the line for high quality and easy to use products. All while working closely with your engineering and design manager partners.
You'll be part of Vanta's Platform organization, which builds the foundational primitives and craft layer the rest of the product is built on. This is the first dedicated Design Systems PM role at Vanta, so you'll help shape the function itself, not just the roadmap. It's a high-autonomy, highly cross-functional role at the center of how Vanta looks, feels, and scales.
What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta:
Own the vision and roadmap for the frontend, spanning the design system and the front-end platform, and ladder durable platform investments to company initiatives so design and engineering can focus on customers.
Evolve our design system from a broad component library into smaller, composable building blocks with consistent APIs, including making components first-class for AI and LLM-driven experiences.
Drive accessibility and internationalization programs to their committed milestones, including global-scale localization and meeting accessibility standards.
Partner with our AI team to enable the agentic patterns product teams need to build the next generation of Vanta experiences.
Run go-to-market and adoption for design-system changes, and lead ongoing quality and "paper cuts" triage as the craft team for the entire product.
Partner closely with your engineering and design leads as a triad, continuously prioritizing the highest-impact work across a wide surface area.
Look 12 to 18 months ahead at how the design system and front-end platform scale with Vanta, including AI-native use.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
Have 4-8+ years of product management experience, with real ownership of a design system, frontend platform, or developer and design experience that served many teams.
Bring craft and taste at scale. You have a clear point of view on quality, you can scale it across many teams, and you earn craft credibility with senior design and product leaders.
Have a builder's mindset. You're not an engineer, but you're hands-on: you spin up prototypes and demos and build with the same component building blocks that your team ships.
Collaborate horizontally and build trust. You serve every product team as an internal platform, build consensus across the company, and you're the partner other teams are glad to see at their door.
Think in systems. You reason about how components, tokens, patterns, and front-end infrastructure fit together and cascade across every product surface.
Tell the story. You translate why front-end and design-system investment matters into clear business value for leadership and cross-functional partners.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

The Cross-APEX Licensing and Entitlement Product Manager is the centralized owner connecting end-to-end licensing, entitlement, metering, usage, aggregation, and governance requirements across multiple business units and platform systems. This is an inbound product management role focused on internal systems governance, cross-organizational alignment, and delivery coordination.
This role operates across entitlement management, metering governance, licensing compliance, and consumption-based business model infrastructure. It establishes the single source of truth for how entitlement and usage data is defined, processed, flows across systems, and enforces compliance and audit standards globally. It is the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Pricing, Legal, Finance, and Compliance teams.

Governance & Intake
Establish and lead a cross-functional governance board that serves as the single intake point for all licensing, entitlement, metering, and usage-related requirements. Define and manage the intake process across all participating teams
Assess cross-system impacts before work enters engineering backlogs
Drive prioritization across teams with independent roadmaps and release cycles
Own the governance model, operating cadence, and review board charter
Lead executive reviews for new or modified meters, entitlements, roles, and licensing policies
Entitlement & Usage Data Governance
Own the end-to-end definition, documentation, and governance of entitlement, licensing, and usage data across the platform ecosystem. Maintain the authoritative entitlement and usage data model
Document data flows, integrations, system interfaces, and dependencies
Identify architectural gaps, overlaps, risks, and compliance issues
Serve as the subject matter expert for cross-system interactions
Partner with Legal and Compliance to define licensing rules, audit controls, and escalation processes
Licensing Strategy, Standards & Tooling
Define the vision, standards, and tooling that enable scalable, compliant licensing and metering across ServiceNow products. Establish licensing and metering governance aligned to commercialization, compliance, and product strategy
Develop a multi-year roadmap supporting subscription and consumption-based business models
Drive tooling for entitlement management, usage tracking, license validation, and audit readiness
Create frameworks, templates, and guidance for product teams defining roles, entitlements, and meters
Lead training, enablement, and adoption of governance standards
Release Integration & Cross-System Coordination
Ensure successful delivery of entitlement and usage-related changes across a complex, distributed systems landscape. Coordinate cross-team release planning and integration for interdependent changes
Proactively identify and escalate integration and testing risks
Establish repeatable testing processes for downstream impact validation
Provide visibility into cross-system dependencies, risks, and delivery readiness

ServiceNow's shift to AI-native and consumption-based models has exposed gaps in how entitlement, licensing, and usage data flows across interconnected systems. Teams operate on separate roadmaps with no unified intake, governance, or compliance framework.

But this fragmentation is also your opportunity to build something transformational—centralizing what's been scattered to eliminate release friction, enable faster shipping, and give the organization the visibility and compliance controls it needs to scale.
Required
12+ years of program or product management experience in complex, cross-functional technical environments
Experience with AI usage, consumption, pricing, and packaging models
Customer engagement experience deriving customer insights and translating those into product roadmaps
Demonstrated experience driving alignment across engineering organizations with independent delivery cycles and tooling
Strong technical fluency—ability to understand and document system architectures, data models, integration flows, and compliance requirements without subject matter expert support
Proven ability to establish governance processes, intake frameworks, and compliance controls that are adopted and sustained across organizations
Experience managing backlogs, roadmaps, and release coordination in environments with competing priorities, multiple stakeholders, and misaligned delivery cycles
Excellent written and verbal communication skills—ability to translate technical complexity into clear executive narratives and cross-team documentation
Experience with cross-organizational program coordination and cross-tool dependency management

Familiarity with entitlement, licensing, subscription management, or metering systems in a SaaS or enterprise software context
Experience working across multiple organizations in delivery models with interdependent systems
Working knowledge of multiple development tooling environments and the challenges of cross-tool dependency visibility
Prior experience running formal governance boards, review committees, or intake processes
Experience with compliance and audit requirements in licensing and subscription contexts
Background in consumption-based or usage-based business model infrastructure
Understanding of commercial model evolution and its technical dependencies

About Revaly
Revaly is the essential infrastructure for payments, protecting revenue, relationships, and the integrity of digital commerce. We make sure what you earn, you keep. Our platform helps performance-driven businesses unlock hidden growth by turning failed or at-risk payments into approved revenue.

We connect merchants and issuers in real time, using intelligence drawn from across the payment ecosystem to make approvals work smarter.

Now, we’re scaling and we’re looking for a Product Manager About the Role As Product Manager, you'll own the discovery, delivery, and continuous optimization of products that help merchants maximize payment performance and revenue recovery.

You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Success, and commercial teams to turn customer needs, business priorities, and platform capabilities into products that deliver measurable outcomes.

Your focus: building critical platform connections and API capabilities that improve payment approvals, drive adoption, and create exceptional customer experiences. What You’ll Be Doing
Own the product lifecycle from discovery through launch and continuous optimization for client-facing products.
Develop and communicate a clear product vision and roadmap aligned with Revaly 's strategic objectives.
Conduct customer research, analyze payment data, gather stakeholder feedback, and monitor market trends to identify high-impact opportunities.
Translate business objectives into detailed product briefs, PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable Engineering to deliver with confidence.
Prioritize and maintain a healthy product backlog using customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
Partner closely with Engineering and Product Design to deliver high-quality features on time while removing blockers and driving decisions quickly.
Lead product optimization initiatives using experimentation, A/B testing, customer feedback, and analytics to improve adoption, engagement, and retention.
Define success metrics, instrumentation requirements, and post-launch reporting to ensure every release is measurable and continuously improved.
Coordinate product launches across Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to ensure successful adoption and enablement.
Work closely with consumers and technical stakeholders to build developer-friendly integrations and improve the overall API experience.
Leverage AI tools, including Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Work, to accelerate product discovery, documentation, backlog refinement, requirements creation, and product execution.

5+ years of Product Management experience building and scaling SaaS products.
Demonstrated success leading products from discovery through launch and ongoing optimization.
Strong experience translating business requirements into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and product documentation.
Experience managing REST APIs or developer-focused products with a strong understanding of API design, integrations, and documentation.
Experience working in Agile product development environments using Jira.
Strong analytical skills with experience using data to prioritize work, measure outcomes, and inform product decisions.
Experience within payments, FinTech, financial infrastructure, or adjacent industries is highly preferred.
Comfortable working in fast-moving startup or high-growth technology environments.
Familiarity and curiosity with AI-powered productivity tools.
Experience using Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Work to improve product management workflows and team productivity.
A calm, confident communicator who thrives in fast-moving, high-accountability environments.
Naturally curious, customer-focused, and comfortable challenging assumptions to find better solutions.
Excellent collaboration, communication, organizational, and prioritization skills with the ability to influence across cross-functional teams.
What Success Looks Like
Within the first 90 days, develop a deep understanding of Revaly 's payments platform, customer workflows, APIs, and product roadmap while establishing strong cross-functional relationships.
Within 6 months, successfully deliver high-impact product initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen API capabilities, and ship on time with measurable business impact.
Improve product adoption, engagement, and customer satisfaction through continuous discovery, experimentation, and iterative product improvements.
Build a consistently prioritized backlog that enables Engineering teams to execute with clarity, speed, and minimal ambiguity.
Establish meaningful product metrics and reporting that drive better product decisions and demonstrate measurable improvements in approval rates, customer adoption, and platform performance.
Become a trusted product partner who brings clarity to complex problems, aligns stakeholders around priorities, and consistently delivers customer and business value.
Why Revaly
We’re a growing global company committed to building a team filled with diverse cultures, viewpoints, and experiences. As they say, variety is the spice of life. No matter how large we become, we will always be connected through our shared sense of community and slightly quirky personalities.

Our vibrant culture is filled with talented, creative, deeply curious, high achievers. We believe in and invest in our people because we know they are the secret to our success. We are happy to extend the following benefits to our employees:
Unlimited paid time off
100% remote work
Flexible hours

What to Expect from the Hiring Process We believe hiring should feel like a conversation, not a test. Here’s what you can expect if you apply: Step 1 — Conversation with People & Culture (30 minutes) If your experience looks like a fit, you’ll meet with our Head of People & Culture for a video chat.

It’s a two-way conversation, we’ll learn about your background, skills, and what energizes you, and you’ll have space to ask about Revaly , our mission, and what it’s like to work here. It’s also a chance to make sure the vibes are right on both sides.

Step 2 — Conversation with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes) Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a deeper dive into your role-specific experience. We’ll talk through real scenarios, how you approach challenges, and what success looks like in this role. You’ll also get a clearer picture of the team’s goals and priorities.

Step 3 — Meet a Future Teammate (60 minutes) In this stage, you’ll meet with someone from the team you’ll work closely with. This is your chance to get an on-the-ground perspective, how the team collaborates, what day-to-day looks like, and the kind of people you’ll be building alongside.

Step 4 — 90 Day Ramp Up Presentation (30 minutes) In this final stage, we ask candidates to prepare and present a 90 day ramp up plan to the hiring manager. This is an opportunity for candidates to outline how they would approach their first 3 months in the role, what they’d aim to learn, prioritize, and accomplish.

This is a chance to show your understanding of the role, the company, and the environment we’re operating in, while giving the hiring manager a glimpse into how you think, structure your approach to learning and communicate your ideas.

We hire for both skill and fit, looking for people who are not just aligned with our values, but who will add to our culture with their ideas, energy, and perspective.

If you’ve applied for a role in Technology or Product Development, you can also expect a skill-based assessment between step 3 and 4, to help us assess some key role-based requirements.

Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities.

We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout.

Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.
This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store.

You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer.

You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

Match Group AI Team Introduction
Match Group AI (MG AI) is the central tech organization that drives innovation across Match Group's global portfolio, including Tinder, Hinge, Azar, Pairs, Match, BLK, etc. Match Group aims to spark meaningful connections for everyone, worldwide, and the MG AI team's role is to bring cutting-edge AI to unblock the challenges along that journey, across diverse domains (e.g., Recommendation, Trust & Safety, Profile Enhancement).
Unlike brand-specific teams (e.g., Tinder, HYPERCONNECT AI), MG AI team offers the unique opportunity to impact the entire Match Group ecosystem. You won't just build for one app; we aim to develop scalable AI solutions that power Tinder, Hinge, and beyond, defining the technological gold standard for the global dating industry.
Detailed article: Introduction to Match Group AI Team (written in Korean)

Working as a Product Manager at MG AI
While engineers focus on building and shipping models, Product Managers at MG AI own the why and the what. We translate complex, often ambiguous business challenges from Match Group's brands into clear ML product strategy, and we drive execution across a globally distributed team. The PMs who thrive here are strategic troubleshooters with a bias for action: they spot what is blocking progress and drive it to resolution instead of waiting.
This is a communication-first role, but that does not mean coordination alone. Your core job is to figure out which problem is worth solving, articulate it in clear and precise language, and drive alignment among a diverse set of stakeholders across cultures and time zones. You own the product thinking end to end: framing the problem, shaping the plan, and defining what we build.
You will work on projects that leverage a wide range of technologies, from on-device ML modules to server-side AI models and LLMs. You do not need to be an ML expert on day one, but you must learn fast and become technically fluent enough to make sound product calls, because the technology and the problems keep changing.

Frame the Problem: Figure out which problems are worth solving and why, and articulate them in clear, precise language that a diverse team can rally around.
Shape the Roadmap: Decide what matters most, sequence the work, make the tradeoffs, and write PRDs, keeping partners aligned as priorities shift.
Navigate Complex Stakeholder Maps: Act as the connective tissue between Match Group's brands, and the many functions within them, and MG AI engineering. Read the unspoken dynamics, build alignment across brands, functions, cultures, and time zones, and keep everyone moving in the same direction.
Hands-on Execution: Stay deeply involved in the details. Use experiments, behavioral data, and research to guide your calls when signals are imperfect, unblock engineering, and make the small decisions that keep a project moving.

Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Management (most important): You excel at managing stakeholders in complex, high-ambiguity situations. You read between the lines, sense interpersonal and organizational dynamics, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities. This is the single most important quality for this role.
4-6 years of product management experience in the Tech domain, ideally on complex systems or data or ML-driven products.
Fast Learning Curve & Strong Will to Learn: You do not need to be ML-savvy today, but you must ramp quickly and become technically fluent enough to shape direction on model behavior and tradeoffs without needing to be deeply technical.
Fluent in English (Able to conduct business meetings and participate in complex discussions without requiring assistance.)
Fluent in Korean (Sophisticated professional interactions with native-level precision and an understanding of cultural nuances.) Essential for cross-functional collaboration within the Seoul office.
Strong Ownership & Bias for Action: A track record of driving problems to resolution without waiting for permission. You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and making principled calls when the signals are imperfect.
Analytical Rigor: Comfort with data. You can define metrics, design and read experiments, and let evidence guide your decisions.
Global Operational Readiness: Ability to accommodate flexible working hours for regular early morning syncs with US teams (EST/PST).

A Point of View on AI Tooling: A clear sense of how AI tools can raise the quality and speed of product work, and a habit of using them (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).
ML Product Experience: Exposure to ML-driven products (Recommendation, Search, Ranking, or Trust & Safety) and a working understanding of the ML lifecycle, from data to online A/B testing.
Matching Products Experience: Experience with products that match people or content (e.g., dating, marketplaces, social feeds, or hiring).
Internal Platform / B2B2C Experience: Success in a role where your primary customers were other internal business units or engineering teams.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Experience working with diverse, globally distributed teams and organizations.

You will perate with high autonomy, and be the Single Threaded Owner (STO) for development and launch of a new product line within 12 months.

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level.

On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score.

About the Role: Credible is looking for an AI-native Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our student loan lending marketplace, our flagship product. You will own and deliver features from ideation through launch, in close collaboration with design, engineering, and data.

Primarily, you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps students and parents discover and compare options across multiple lenders. This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build.

In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources. You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler.

Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant. Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the product's vision and direction and to achieve team OKRs. Responsibilities:
Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the student loan marketplace and align them with Credible 's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the student loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps students and parents discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
Own the Roadmap: Manage roadmaps for both private student loans and student loan refinance products by identifying opportunities, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove when it isn't earning its place.
Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross-functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Student lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.
As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools.

You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams.

Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.
Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.
What you’ll need
Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.
What success looks like
Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists.

You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Du bewertest AI-Output kritisch, statt ihn unreflektiert zu übernehmen - Du erkennst Halluzinationen und schwache Annahmen.
Du verstehst, wo AI in unseren Produkten selbst Creator-Mehrwert schaffen kann und denkst das aktiv in Deiner Priorisierung mit.

Du besitzt Erfahrung mit Creator-/Freelancer-Plattformen, Subscription-Flows oder Content-Monetarisierung.
Du hast bereits in einem regulatorisch komplexen Umfeld gearbeitet.

Dabei sind ein Höchstmaß an Flexibilität, bedingungslose Kundenorientierung und eine ausgesprochene Hands-On Mentalität die Grundpfeiler unserer täglichen Arbeit. Vielfach von der Fachpresse ausgezeichnet und mit besten Kundenbewertungen sind wir der führende PC-Systembuilder in Deutschland.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Produktmanagement-Teams suchen wir aktuell einen Produktmanager – PC-Komponenten & Systemkonfiguration (m/w/d) . In dieser Rolle bringst Du ein breites Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen und Komponentenökosysteme mit und entwickelst diesen Bereich innerhalb unseres Produktmanagements aktiv weiter. Du bist der Spezialist für das Zusammenspiel der Teile – mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Kühlung, Lüfter und Gehäuse, aber nie ohne den Blick aufs Gesamtsystem.
Deine Aufgaben: Als Produktmanager – PC-Komponenten & Systemkonfiguration (m/w/d) verantwortest Du Sortiment, Prozesse und Lieferantenbeziehungen in Deinen Warengruppen und bringst gleichzeitig Dein Systemverständnis ein, um unser Konfigurationsangebot kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Der Schwerpunkt liegt im Produktmanagement – ergänzt um einkaufsnahe Aufgaben wie Verhandlungen und Konditionsgestaltung.
Deine täglichen To-Dos umfassen vor allem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:
Du übernimmst die Sortimentsstrategie für PC-Komponenten mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Kühler, Lüfter und Gehäuse – von der Produktauswahl und technischen Validierung über Kompatibilitätsprüfungen bis hin zur Weiterentwicklung des Gesamtportfolios
Du bringst ein ganzheitliches Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen mit; Du denkst nicht in einzelnen Bauteilen, sondern erkennst, wie Komponenten im System zusammenwirken und nutzt dieses Wissen, um unser Konfigurationsangebot gezielt weiterzuentwickeln
Du übernimmst das Vendor Management für Deine Warengruppen und bist interner Hauptansprechpartner für Hersteller und Distributoren in allen technischen und kommerziellen Fragestellungen
Du führst Lieferantenverhandlungen zu Einkaufskonditionen, Rahmenverträgen, Rabattstaffeln und Sonderaktionen und optimierst so kontinuierlich unsere Marge und Verfügbarkeit
Du bewertest neue Produkte technisch fundiert hinsichtlich Kompatibilität, Leistung und Verarbeitungsqualität – bei Lüftern und Kühlern spielen dabei auch Design und Ästhetik eine wichtige Rolle: Formgebung, Beleuchtungskonzepte und aktuelle Optik-Trends beeinflussen die Kaufentscheidung unserer Kunden
Du behältst Markt-, Trend- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen im Blick und leitest daraus Sortiments- und Preisentscheidungen ab
Du pflegst und verwaltest die Artikel Deiner Warengruppen inklusive technischer Detaildaten in unserem Warenwirtschaftssystem und Onlineshop
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktmanagement-Prozesse aktiv voran – von Forecasting und Reporting bis zur abteilungsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Produktion und Service
Du stehst im engen Austausch mit anderen Teams aus den Bereichen Einkauf, Produktion und Service, um Sortiments- und Verfügbarkeitsthemen frühzeitig zu klären
Dein Profil: Bei MIFCOM hören wir nie auf zu lernen und uns weiterzuentwickeln. Wir glauben daran, dass eine perfekte Mischung aus technischem Fachwissen, kaufmännischem Verständnis und Soft-Skills einen guten Kandidaten auszeichnet. Unser Anforderungsprofil ist eine erste Richtlinie, aber wir sind immer auf der Suche nach Persönlichkeiten, die ihre eigene Perspektive und den Willen, etwas zu bewegen, mitbringen.
Als unser idealer Kandidat bringst Du folgende Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen mit:
Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit kaufmännischem oder technischem Schwerpunkt (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Informatik) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Category Management oder Einkauf mit, idealerweise im Bereich PC-Hardware, Consumer Electronics oder Gaming
Du hast ein breites technisches Verständnis für PC-Konfigurationen und Komponentenökosysteme – Du verstehst, wie Teile zusammenspielen, und erkennst, wo Optimierungspotenzial liegt; Kühler, Lüfter und Gehäuse sind dabei Dein natürlicher Schwerpunkt
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Design und Ästhetik, insbesondere bei Lüftern und Kühlern, und erkennst, welche Optik und welches Beleuchtungskonzept bei unserer Zielgruppe ankommt
Du hast Erfahrung in Lieferantenverhandlungen und verhandelst sicher und zielorientiert, ohne dabei die technische Perspektive aus den Augen zu verlieren
Du denkst prozessorientiert, bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Abläufen ein und treibst deren Umsetzung eigenständig voran
Du begeisterst Dich auch privat für PC-Hardware, Software und Gaming und bist ständig up-to-date, was Trends und neue Produkte angeht
Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise zählen zu Deinen Stärken
Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
Warum MIFCOM? Performance steht bei allem, was wir tun, im Mittelpunkt. Unsere Produkte erfüllen die höchsten Anforderungen unserer Kunden; der Name MIFCOM steht für Zuverlässigkeit, Präzision und ein Maximum an Leistung.

Ein spannender, anspruchsvoller und abwechslungsreicher Job in einem engagierten Team mit einer "Du"-Kultur und familiärer Atmosphäre
Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit attraktiver Vergütung, sowie flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und all das beim führenden PC-Systemintegrator
Eine Home-Office-Möglichkeit und individuelle Gestaltung des Arbeitsplatzes sowie technischer Ausstattung (PC, Monitore, Peripherie, etc.)
Viel Freiraum und Möglichkeiten, Deine Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen
Individuelle Weiterbildungen, je nach persönlichen Interessen & Schwerpunkten samt zahlreichen Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen
Arbeit mit neuester Computerhardware und neuesten Technologien - mache Dein Hobby zum Beruf
Kostenfreier Kaffee & Getränke sowie fußläufig gut erreichbare Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Foodtrucks und Restaurants
Nach der Probezeit: z.B. betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad, attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen, uvm.
Sonstige Benefits, wie z.B. 30 Tage Urlaub, Fitness-Abo (EGYM Wellpass), Corporate Benefits, etc.

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Civil Industrial, Ingeniero/a en Informática o carrera afín, con experiencia implementando soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el segmento financiero. En TCIT valoramos a profesionales que puedan liderar el “puente” entre negocio y tecnología: traducir necesidades, ordenar el trabajo del equipo y sostener el foco en el resultado.
Requisitos y experiencia
Formación: Ingeniería Industrial, Informática y/o Civil.
Experiencia implementando soluciones tecnológicas y productos digitales en el sector financiero.
Dominio de metodologías ágiles para la gestión de productos y la coordinación con equipos.
Habilidades de comunicación para alinear requerimientos con heads de negocio y stakeholders.
Experiencia en empresas de Banca y/o Fintech.
Manejo de Inglés B1-B2
Competencias y habilidades personales
Orientación a resultados y capacidad para priorizar según valor de negocio.
Pensamiento analítico: ordenar información, gestionar dependencias y detectar riesgos.
Alta coordinación y seguimiento: sostener el backlog, la planificación y la entrega incremental.
Comunicación clara y proactiva, adaptando el lenguaje entre negocio y tecnología.
Colaboración: trabajo efectivo con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y áreas internas.
Si te entusiasma liderar productos digitales con enfoque en calidad y sostenibilidad, y disfrutas trabajar con equipos ágiles en entornos Cloud, este desafío es para ti.
Nuestra misión es asegurar que las soluciones digitales evolucionen de forma ordenada, medible y alineada al negocio. Tu foco será convertir necesidades y oportunidades en un backlog claro y accionable, liderando la planificación y el seguimiento del producto durante todo su ciclo de vida.

Liderar el ciclo de vida de las soluciones digitales: discovery, definición, planificación, entrega y mejora continua.
Transformar iniciativas de negocio en un backlog claro, priorizado y mantenido (con criterios de valor, alcance y dependencias).
Gestionar el presupuesto del producto/solución, coordinando costos, recursos y planificación con las áreas correspondientes.
Coordinar con proveedores, equipos de desarrollo y stakeholders para asegurar ejecución efectiva y alineamiento.
Definir y hacer seguimiento de objetivos del producto, métricas y resultados esperados, para una gestión basada en datos.
Dominar metodologías ágiles (por ejemplo, Scrum/Kanban) y asegurar prácticas saludables de trabajo con los equipos.
Trabajar con tecnologías Cloud en AWS (u otras), comprendiendo el impacto de decisiones de arquitectura en el producto.
Alinear requerimientos con los heads de negocio, asegurando claridad, trazabilidad y acuerdos sobre alcance.
En este rol, buscamos que aportes criterio para equilibrar valor, esfuerzo y riesgo, manteniendo una comunicación fluida entre negocio, tecnología y terceros.
*Contrato directo con el Cliente
Modalidad inicialmente presencial (3 primeros meses), luego 1-2 días remoto, resto presencial.
Oficinas ubicadas en la Comuna de las Condes, cercano a metro Tobalaba.

Experiencia en gestión de equipos de más de 5 personas.
Fuerte capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos técnicos y metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).

Validar y aprobar entregables, asegurando la calidad y coherencia del producto.
Liderar la comunicación con stakeholders, reportando avances, riesgos y oportunidades.

Detectar oportunidades de mejora y proponer nuevas funcionalidades que impulsen el crecimiento y la conversión de la App.

Experiencia en plataformas e-commerce (especialmente VTEX).
Certificaciones en Product Management o metodologías ágiles (CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, etc.).
Conocimiento en herramientas de analytics y data-driven product management.
Plan de desarrollo profesional con certificaciones y cursos (incluyendo idiomas).
Computadora proporcionada y ambiente informal.
Cultura de innovación y aprendizaje continuo en un equipo multidisciplinario.

About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1.

Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps.

The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France.

Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs , you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain.

You’ll have the backing of a parentcompany leading innovation in engineering and manufacturing, with direct access toreal hardware programs and the engineers who run them. Who We’re Looking For We’re looking for a hands-on product leader who came up through hardware.

Youmight have been an NPI or hardware program manager, a systems or EE lead who ranprograms, or a product manager embedded deep in hardware development. Whatever thepath, you understand how a real program actually runs.

You’ve takenproducts from 0 to 1, you’re energized by a blank page, and you’d rather get threethings in front of users than perfect one deck. This is a builder’s role. You’ll report directly to Reflow’s general manager, who ownsoverall product vision and strategy.

Your job is to own execution, discovery, andthe details, and to be the person who makes the right product real and ships it ontime. You should already be using AI tools to accelerate your own work, and youshould be excited to build the first AI-native platform for complex hardwaredevelopment.

customer-facingmaterial, because writing is how product gets built here Prototyping and demoing, putting things in front of users early, running thedemo yourself, and iterating on what you learn Location Our Technical Product Owner - DoiT Cloud Intelligence - Core Services will be an integral part of our global Product team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity We’re hiring a Technical Product Owner to drive rapid delivery and iteration for the Core Services team of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, our platform that helps DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and FinOps teams manage public cloud environments effectively and efficiently.

Core Services builds and operates foundational platform capabilities used across DoiT’s products and engineering teams. Its responsibilities include identity and access management, authentication and authorization, customer and tenant services, shared APIs, platform integrations, and other cross-cutting capabilities.

This role is designed for someone with a technical product mindset who is comfortable working deep within platform architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows.

You will help turn broad platform needs into clear technical product direction, sequenced investments, and reliably delivered capabilities. You will report to a VP of Product and work as an embedded member of the Core Services Engineering team.

You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, architects, security, product teams, and internal platform consumers to determine what the team should build next and why. Role clarity: VP of Product vs. Technical Product Owner VP of Product (what they own)
Sets the overall vision, strategy, positioning, and long-range roadmap for the platform area.
Makes the highest-level prioritization calls across multiple components and investment themes.
Aligns stakeholders across the company (executive leadership, GTM, partners) on direction and tradeoffs.
Defines success at the portfolio/area level and ensures the area’s outcomes ladder up to company goals.
Technical Product Owner (what you own)
Owns delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for the Core Services.
Turns VP-level direction into clear problems to solve, a prioritized backlog, and incrementally shippable scope.
Runs the feedback loop: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Works within the Engineering teams to ensure they are always building the highest-value next increment with clarity, quality
Review technical designs, reason about tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer
Leverages deep, hands-on DevOps experience and public cloud understanding to ensure that solution implementations are done correctly
This distinction matters: the VP creates the “why” and “where”; the Product Owner ensures the “what next” is always sharp, validated, and shipping. Responsibilities Fast iteration and backlog leadership
Translate the VP’s strategy into a sequenced backlog of problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the Engineering team can deliver continuously.
Keep work “thin-sliced” so the team can ship frequently, learn quickly, and reduce risk through iteration.
Maintain a disciplined cadence of backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and scope negotiation to keep delivery predictable without slowing innovation.
Deep user and workflow understanding
Leverage your hands-on DevOps experience and expertise in the real-world workflows of the professionals you’re building for - especially cloud operators and practitioners.
Use firsthand domain knowledge and ongoing customer conversations to identify friction, gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
Prioritize enhancements that materially improve outcomes: speed, reliability, clarity, safety, governance, cost impact, or operational simplicity.
Customer validation and external communication
Often speak with customers (aiming for 3-5 calls a week) and cross-functional DoiT stakeholders regularly to test ideas, validate assumptions, and pressure-test tradeoffs.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into decisions, and explain “why” in a way that builds trust.
Rely on your hands-on, DevOps experience to go deep with stakeholders (internal/external) into the technical details of the problem, our solution, and the contexts and environments in which both of these exist.
Support beta/design-partner motions where appropriate by shaping hypotheses, success criteria, and rollout plans.
Engineering-embedded technical product ownership
Operate as a core member of the Core Services’ Engineering team - present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning - ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
Ensure Core Services are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior - and that it meets a high bar for reliability and customer trust.
Quality, outcomes, and measurement
Define what “success” means for Core Services with clear metrics (adoption, activation, workflow completion, time-to-value, retention, reliability signals, customer-reported impact).
Instrument learning: make sure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into prioritization.
Own release readiness for Core Services: documentation, enablement inputs, and clear communication of what’s new and why it matters.
Safety, governance, and trust by design
Ensure product requirements account for real-world cloud environments: IAM boundaries, auditability, guardrails, and safe defaults.
Partner with security, support, and customer teams to anticipate edge cases and ensure Core Services earns trust over time.

7–10 years of hands-on experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Solutions Architect, or a similar roles working with or building products for public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure).
A strong product sense for turning messy problems into clear scope and shipped value - without waiting for perfect information.
Systems thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, architectural tradeoffs, and long-term platform evolution.
Prioritization: Demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, engineering constraints, and platform investments when making prioritization decisions.

Rejoins une superstar de la foodtech française
Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scales up françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Si tu souhaites prendre part à cette incroyable aventure humaine, internationale et entrepreneuriale, rejoins-nous !

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Senior Product Manager rockstar dans notre équipe Produit. En tant que Senior Product Manager, tu seras au cœur de la stratégie d’amélioration de notre produit, et de nos nouveaux lancements, et à l’intersection de plusieurs équipes et projets clés pour l’entreprise.
Il ne s’agit pas simplement de gestion de projet, mais d’un poste clé où tu pourras façonner la vision produit physique d'HelloFresh en France.

Mais au-delà de définir la direction, c’est un rôle où il faut faire le lien entre stratégie, données et exécution, en pilotant des initiatives cross-fonctionnelles complexes de la conception jusqu'à l’exécution.

Ce rôle se caractérise par sa diversité : tu pourrais passer une journée à creuser des données de rétention client, la suivante à coordonner le déploiement d'un produit innovant à la croisée entre nos équipes Culinaire, Menu Planning et Ops, et la troisième à présenter une stratégie de monétisation au CEO.
Si tu veux être au cœur des tendances food and impacter la manière dont nos consommateurs voient notre produit chaque semaine, alors ce poste est fait pour toi !

Construire la roadmap stratégique de notre produit, identifier et quantifier les prochains relais de croissance liées à notre offre, sur la base d’analyses sur notre produit physique (données clients, performance produit), et d’une compréhension solide des tendances de marché,
Porter notre stratégie d’innovation produit: offres de recettes tendance et différenciées, nouvelles fonctionnalités, etc. en lien avec les équipes Produit Globales, pour réinventer l’expérience culinaire de nos clients,
Orchestrer de bout en bout des lancements de produits à fort impact, en fédérant les équipes culinaire, menus, produit digital, marketing et production autour d'une vision commune,
Concevoir une offre de monétisation ambitieuse et rentable — recettes premium, épicerie, swap d'ingrédients — pour maximiser la valeur perçue et la performance financière,
Faire évoluer notre produit digital aux côtés des équipes Tech et Produit Globales, en relayant les besoins clients afin de les transformer en fonctionnalités concrètes.

Senior Product Manager (ShelfView)
Scandit ZURICH
Imagine the what. Build the how.
Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.
Your opportunity
As a Product Manager for ShelfView Capture , you will own the strategy and roadmap for how ShelfView acquires shelf data — a cornerstone of ShelfView's hybrid data capture . You'll work at the intersection of UX, mobile engineering, and computer vision to make capture fast, simple, and reliable, and to ensure the right shelf data is collected at the right quality, coverage, and cost.
ShelfView turns images and video from mobile devices, fixed cameras, and autonomous robots into a digital twin of the store, generating insights that remove tedious tasks for retail workers. Your mission is to make the capture experience best-in-class for accuracy, cost, and speed.

Partner with customers and field teams to understand capture environments and translate needs into requirements.
Build and drive the ShelfView capture roadmap toward high throughput, coverage, and quality at the right cost.
Define and deliver a better capture experience (e.g., improved video capture, AR guidance, faster and more reliable first-time-right capture).
Own how capture work is tasked and scheduled — which stores and aisles are captured, how often, and by whom.
Own store onboarding and modeling — getting stores ready (mapping, planograms, catalogs) and keeping them current as stores change.
Define capture quality, product metrics, and telemetry , and run experiments to inform iterative development.
Work closely with design, mobile engineering, and CV teams to evaluate new technologies that improve capture success
Drive non-mobile, hybrid capture (fixed camera, robot and emerging technologies).
Coordinate feature launches with product marketing and sales operations; act as the capture point of contact on pilots and early customer rollouts.

Degree in Engineering or a related field.
6+ years of product management experience in a "Deep Tech" or mobile SaaS company, or equivalent product leadership experience in a startup.
Experience with mobile apps, AR use-cases, or on-device ML is beneficial.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to identify user needs; comfortable working hands-on with data/telemetry.
Open-minded, sociable, and driven personality.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.
Eligible to work in Switzerland.
Ability to visit customers in Europe and North America on occasion.

Liberis is in the middle of a meaningful shift. We started as a single-product business and are quickly becoming a truly multi-product embedded finance company, with different funding structures, revenue models and customer relationships sitting alongside each other in the same portfolio. That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange!

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis.

You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale!

You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running.

That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities.

This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you!

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. Working with stakeholders across commercial, credit, finance and operations, you will define what good looks like and then work with your team to build it. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes.

You will also spend a meaningful amount of time in the detail, reviewing data models and dashboards, asking hard questions about definitions, and making sure what we ship is accurate and trusted.

You will partner closely with the engineering side of your team on how data is modelled and structured in BigQuery and DBT, and with analysts on how it gets presented in Looker. You don't need to write production code, but you need enough technical understanding to be a genuine partner in those conversations. You will also be responsible for continuing to expand our partner-facing reporting, whereby partners gain visibility into their portfolio.

This role requires someone who can think clearly about complex data structures and translate that thinking into products that non-technical people actually find useful. The ideal person has strong conceptual thinking skills, great product instincts and enough technical depth to earn the trust of the engineers and analysts they work with.

· Proven experience in a senior data product or analytics product role in a business with real complexity

· A track record of helping commercial teams make better decisions through better data, not just shipping dashboards

· Strong ability to think about entities, taxonomies and relationships in data

· Hands-on experience with Looker and LookML and familiarity with best practices and scalable approaches to these systems

· Working knowledge of SQL, DBT and BigQuery, enough to engage seriously with how data is modelled and what's feasible, and to express your thinking in code-speak where needed

· Experience working with a multi skilled team of analysts and data engineers

· Clear, confident communication with senior commercial stakeholders

Next steps If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!

At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Deine Mission
Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Technology und Data.
Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können.
Das erwartet Dich
Prozesse gestalten statt verwalten
Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, hinterfragst etablierte Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen effizientere, skalierbare und automatisierte Lösungen.
Business und Technologie verbinden
Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus Lösungskonzepte und stimmst deren Umsetzung mit unseren Engineering-Teams und externen Softwarepartnern ab.
Daten intelligent nutzen
Gemeinsam mit unserem BI-Team entwickelst Du KPIs, Reports und Dashboards. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, erstellst Du Analysen auch selbst – beispielsweise mit BigQuery oder Tableau.
Automatisierung vorantreiben
Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
Fraud bekämpfen
Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse zur Fraud Detection & Prevention kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Datenanalysen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen.
Business-Plattformen weiterentwickeln
Du arbeitest an Themen wie Payments, Billing, Partnerabrechnung, Revenue Reporting, Datenqualität und Prozessautomatisierung und entwickelst unsere Systemlandschaft kontinuierlich weiter.
Du passt zu uns, wenn Du ...
gerne komplexe Zusammenhänge verstehst und vereinfachst

At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

Strong traditional product-management background across several of: pricing, risk, compliance, product performance, legal, communication, partnering, and go-to-market.

Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to shape company-level product communication and executive-ready written theses.
